firm_data.firm_description: Porzio, Bromberg & Newman, P.C. is a full-service law firm with more than 100 attorneys across offices in New Jersey, New York, Massachusetts, Delaware, Pennsylvania, Florida, and Puerto Rico. The firm's lawyers collaborate across disciplines to deliver practical, forward-thinking solutions for clients ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies.
notable_facts: Has wholly-owned subsidiaries Porzio Governmental Affairs and Porzio Compliance Services.
Named a "Legal Technology Trailblazer" by National Law Journal in 2022 for Porzio Life Sciences and Porzio Compliance Digest.
technology_signals: Developed Porzio Life Sciences, LLC and the company's pioneering product, Porzio Compliance Digest
Developing an automated life sciences supply chain licensing platform

email.subject: AI for Porzio, Bromberg & Newman, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Mark,

Your work developing Porzio Compliance Digest caught my attention. It's clear you're already thinking about how technology can solve real client problems in specialized verticals like life sciences.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Parsippany office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping firms like Porzio compete with BigLaw while staying focused on specialized solutions.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
